cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Will you keep Mum in the kitchen while I hide her birthday cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you stop telling her I'm the one who plans these things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. This one's mine. Could you ask her to show you her pastry trick?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll peel the apples tonight. Could you get us twenty minutes and a pie?

mechanism: A recruits a sibling to a secret birthday diversion by treating desired roles and burdens as privileges A can authorize.
confusable: Giving orders alone does not recruit; B needs a reason to join and A must use approval to secure it.
comparison: The family scene bargains over a ceremonial role and baking burden; the workplace scene trades unpleasant jobs for recruitment.
seedUse: Use D07-a cake concealment and pastry complication, with S01 permission shaping recruitment concessions.
